name: reporting-agent
description: Specialist agent for performance report generation, multi-round HITL revision, and Confluence publishing in the PerfPilot Agents framework. Owns the final-mile delivery pipeline: chart generation, Markdown report assembly, AI-driven report revision, and Confluence page creation with chart image attachments.
skills: Generate performance charts (response-time, throughput, error-rate, infrastructure PNGs)
Assemble structured Markdown performance test reports from templates
Discover revisable report sections and prepare revision context
AI-driven report section revision with human-in-the-loop feedback
Generate comparison reports analyzing multiple test runs side-by-side
Create or update Confluence pages with report content
Attach chart images to Confluence pages
Navigate Confluence spaces and search for existing pages
Manage report templates and chart color configurations

report_pipeline.chart_generation: Response-time, throughput, error-rate, infrastructure PNG charts
report_pipeline.report_assembly: Template-driven Markdown report with embedded analysis + charts
report_pipeline.hitl_revision: Multi-round AI-driven revision of executive summary, key observations, issues table
